title: Publish the purpose and consent-notice register for User personal data
description: Write a register that the DPO approves. It lists every personal-data field of the User document in onfinance_db_model_master/models.py (class User, lines 387-429): user_email, user_phone_number, user_full_name, user_country, user_arrival_origin, user_entities_watchlisted, user_insights_bookmarked, user_entities_explored, user_insights_read, user_portfolio_holdings, user_chats, profile_answers and smallcase_id. Map each field to one or more specified purposes, each with a stable purpose id (for example pur-onboarding, pur-portfolio-insights, pur-chat-assistant). Give each purpose the notice version that covers it (a stable notice_version id such as notice-2026-09-v1). For each notice version, record where the notice text is served, its withdrawal link and its link to the Data Protection Board complaint channel (DPDP Rules 2025 Rule 3). Task 2 uses these purpose and notice ids as the allowed values for the new model fields. This is a documentation change only, so no deployment window applies.
acceptanceCriteria: A register document exists and maps each of the 13 listed User fields to at least one purpose id. No personal-data field in class User is left unmapped.
Each purpose id names a notice_version id, and each notice version records its notice text location, withdrawal link and Board complaint link.
The register shows DPO approval (name, date) and is attached to this task's evidence.

verificationMethod.description: The ciso compares the register with class User in onfinance_db_model_master/models.py at the pinned commit. Expected result: every personal-data field in the class appears in the register with a purpose id and a notice_version id, and each notice version lists withdrawal and complaint links.

rootCause.description: No documented set of purpose ids or notice versions existed, so the data model had nothing it could reference when a User record was created.
